title: Fast high-quality MRI protocol of the lumbar spine with deep learning-based algorithm: an image quality and scanning time comparison with standard protocol
summary: A prospective comparison of deep-learning reconstruction and routine lumbar-spine MRI measured image quality, reader confidence and scan time. The study reports higher SNR and roughly half the acquisition time in healthy volunteers; this is a narrow imaging-protocol result, not evidence of disease-detection accuracy or patient benefit.
organization: Department of Medical Surgical Sciences and Translational Medicine, University of Rome “Sapienza” Radiology Unit - Sant’Andrea University Hospital, Rome, Italy
